tnk.jei.scrolls.1: Use two Deployers to automate eligible Scroll Forge spells.
tnk.jei.scrolls.2: Preparation: Paper + a school focus makes an Unfinished Scroll.
tnk.jei.scrolls.3: Binding: Unfinished Scroll + the appropriate ink makes the selected spell scroll and level.
tnk.jei.scrolls.4: Install a Create Filter in each Deployer: use an allow-list with Respect Data enabled.
tnk.jei.scrolls.5: Include one exact output AND the ingredient held by that Deployer. The filter also controls hand restocking.
tnk.jei.scrolls.6: Filters are reusable. Each completed scroll consumes one Paper, one focus and one ink, matching Scroll Forge costs.
tnk.jei.scrolls.7: Missing or ambiguous output selections stop processing. Ink determines the native spell level.
tnk.jei.scrolls.8: Spells requiring player research and spells disabled for crafting remain on their native acquisition paths.
tnk.jei.paintballs.1: Crushing Wheels produce exactly one AE2 paintball per operation.
tnk.jei.paintballs.2: Red, Green, Yellow, Blue and Purple each have a 20% chance.
tnk.jei.paintballs.3: Draining follows Red → Green → Yellow → Blue → Purple, producing 10 mB of Uncommon Ink at each step.
tnk.jei.paintballs.4: Extract Purple before the final draining step, which produces Gray and another 10 mB of ink.
tnk.jei.chromatic.1: Drop Chromatic Compound into an active Beacon beam to obtain Refined Radiance.
tnk.jei.chromatic.2: Create also supports its native light-source and void transformations when enabled in the world settings.
tnk.jei.chromatic.3: A Convergence Lens converts Chromatic Compound into Shadow Steel.
tnk.jei.boot_drive.1: Craft with Mechanical Crafters using a 16k ME Item Storage Cell, Radiant Coil and Block of Lapis Lazuli.
tnk.jei.boot_drive.2: The Boot Drive is retained during Unstable Creation Core assembly; that operation does not consume durability.
tnk.jei.creation_core.1: Assembly makes two complete passes through Rotation, Sealed, Precision, Calculation, Reinforced, Industrial, Arcane and Eclipse Mechanisms, then a Matter Construct.
tnk.jei.creation_core.2: The full recipe uses 18 deployments. Eight Creation Cores around a Block of Netherite craft the Creation Machine.
tnk.jei.gem.1: Use an Eclipse Lens to process one Dye-Entangled Singularity into one Unstable Creation Gem.
tnk.jei.gem.2: Processing takes 1,000 ticks at 32 RPM. Higher speeds follow the laser’s normal speed scaling.
tnk.jei.gem.3: Only one item is processed per cycle, even when the input is a full stack. The lens is retained.
tnk.jei.rubber.1: A Rubberworks Compressor consumes 500 mB of Resin to produce one Raw Rubber.
tnk.jei.rubber.2: Place a lit campfire or another valid passive heater directly below the Compressor.
tnk.jei.rubber.3: Smoke Raw Rubber to make Cured Rubber.
tnk.jei.building.1: Find the first sample while exploring.
tnk.jei.building.2: A factory batch combines seven End Stone with one sample to produce eight blocks.
tnk.jei.building.3: Return one block to the next batch and send the other seven to your building supply.
tnk.jei.ae2_processing.1: Use Create Sequenced Assembly instead of an Inscriber.
tnk.jei.ae2_processing.2: Print the circuit with a reusable press in a Deployer, then use a Mechanical Press.
tnk.jei.ae2_processing.3: Assemble each processor with Redstone and Printed Silicon, followed by another pressing step.
tnk.jei.ae2_processing.4: Meteorite loot supplies the first AE2 processor presses. Press-copying assembly retains the original press.
tnk.jei.ie_replacements.1: Create machines replace several Immersive Engineering production stations.
tnk.jei.ie_replacements.2: Use Mechanical Presses for plates, Rolling Mills for wire, Mechanical Saws for cutting, and Deployers with reusable molds for rods and bullets.
tnk.jei.ie_replacements.3: Mixers handle alloying and fluid recipes; Basins handle pressing and compacting. Mechanical Crafters handle manufacturing recipes.
tnk.jei.ie_replacements.4: Fermentation uses Create Diesel Generators. Its fuels replace Immersive Engineering ethanol, plant oil and biodiesel.
tnk.jei.ie_replacements.5: IE Crushers, Arc Furnaces, Coke Ovens, Blast Furnaces and Excavators remain part of the factory.
tnk.jei.ore_processing.1: Raw Ore → Crushing Wheels: two Crushed Ore.
tnk.jei.ore_processing.2: Each Crushed Ore → IE Crusher: two Metal Dust. This yields four dust per original Raw Ore.
tnk.jei.ore_processing.3: Four Metal Dust → Eclipse Lens: five ingots. Ordinary dust cooking remains one ingot per dust.
tnk.jei.ore_processing.4: Supported finished metals cannot be ground back into dust or Crushed Ore through the pack’s recipes.
tnk.jei.nuclear.1: Normal cooking follows this world’s Nuclear Furnace settings.
tnk.jei.nuclear.2: When dedicated Nuclear Furnace recipes are enabled, additional recovery and processing recipes appear here alongside normal cooking.

tnk.jei.rotation.1: Apply two Andesite Alloys to a wooden slab, then use the Diesel Generators Hammer in the final Deployer.
tnk.jei.rotation.2: The hammer stays in the Deployer and loses one durability per mechanism.
tnk.jei.rotation.3: Craft the Diesel Generators Hammer with three Andesite Alloys, four iron ingots and two sticks.
tnk.jei.empty_tube.title: Shared Empty Tube
tnk.jei.empty_tube.1: Mechanically craft one Iron Sheet above one Glass block to make an Empty Tube.
tnk.jei.empty_tube.2: Fill it with 300 mB Mana for a Mana Tube, or deploy a Polished Spectral Ruby onto it for a Spectral Ruby Electron Tube.
